6. INVERSE KINEMATICS AND LEG FORCES AT A DESIGN POSE
Rotation R = R_z(ψ)·R_y(θ)·R_x(φ).  World joint qᵢ = t + R·pᵢ with t = [x, y, H₀ + z].  Leg vector Lᵢ = qᵢ − Bᵢ.
Closure |Lᵢ − a(cos αᵢ uᵢ + sin αᵢ k)| = l  ⇒  (Lᵢ·uᵢ)cos αᵢ + L_z sin αᵢ = Gᵢ,  Gᵢ = (|Lᵢ|² + a² − l²)/(2a).  With Mᵢ = √((Lᵢ·uᵢ)² + L_z²) and ψᵢ = atan2(L_z, Lᵢ·uᵢ):  αᵢ = ψᵢ − acos(Gᵢ/Mᵢ).
Statics: Σ fᵢnᵢ + F_ext = 0 and Σ (qᵢ − t)×fᵢnᵢ + M_ext = 0  ⇒  W·f = −w_ext.  Crank torque τᵢ = fᵢ·a·(nᵢ·tᵢ) with crank tangent tᵢ = −sin αᵢ uᵢ + cos αᵢ k.
Wrench matrix W (columns = legs; rows = F_x, F_y, F_z, M_x, M_y, M_z)

9. HEAVE TIME HISTORY  (finite differences on the exact crank angle)

For pure heave every leg has the same angle: αᵢ(z) from Section 6 with t = [0, 0, H₀ + z].  α̇ ≈ (α_{k+1} − α_{k−1})/(2Δt),  α̈ ≈ (α_{k+1} − 2α_k + α_{k−1})/Δt².  Leg torque τ ≈ τ_static·(1 + z̈/g) is checked against τ_avail.
10. FREEDOM OF MOTION (single-axis sweeps through the inverse kinematics)
Each row solves all six crank angles for one pose. A pose is reachable when every Gᵢ/Mᵢ lies in [−1, 1] and every |αᵢ| ≤ α_max.
Roll and pitch about the platform center:  M = I·α_ang + m·g·h_cg·sin(angle).  Leg force needed for a pure moment about x:  Σ fᵢ (pᵢ × nᵢ)_x = M.
